title: Quality Control — Supreme Art
description: Documented quality assurance across every stage of pharmaceutical carton production — from incoming board to final inspection, with full batch traceability.

commitment.heading: Built for pharma standards.
commitment.text: Medicine packaging doesn’t get second chances. We run documented quality assurance across every stage of production, with full batch traceability, so what leaves our floor is exactly what you approved. Colour is matched by a specialised team against Pantone standards and verified on press with a spectrophotometer; every unit carton passes an automated camera inspection; and a digital job card follows each order from board to delivery.

process.heading: Quality checks at every stage.
process.intro: From incoming paperboard to the cartons released for delivery, our QC team records and verifies the details that protect every product, print run and customer approval.

steps.title: Incoming board inspection
steps.text: Before printing begins, every batch of paper, duplex board, bleach board or film-laminated board is checked for grammage, thickness, surface condition and overall quality, and only released to cutting once it matches the specification for the job.
steps.caption_2: Weighing a board sample on a precision scale

steps.title: Safe material handling
steps.text: Paperboard and printed sheets are moved on hand pallet lifters, so every stack travels supported, square and undamaged, and our team never has to lift heavy loads by hand.
steps.caption_2: Die-cut sheets moved safely on a pallet lifter

steps.title: Shade card approval
steps.text: A reference shade card is prepared for every product, matched against Pantone formula guides by our colour team and approved by the client before the final printing run is released. The approved card then travels with the job.
steps.caption_2: Reviewing the shade card with the print team
steps.caption_3: Recording the approved reference in the shade card file

steps.title: In-house CTP plate making
steps.text: Our own advanced computer-to-plate (CTP) system images the approved artwork directly onto the printing plate. Keeping plate making in-house gives sharp, accurate plates and consistent print quality from the first sheet to the last.
steps.caption_2: Each plate is processed and cleaned before it goes to press

steps.title: Printing quality control
steps.text: During printing, our QC team uses a colour spectrophotometer to verify every shade against the approved targets, while checking registration, text content and barcodes against the approved proof. Up to six colours are controlled at the press console throughout the run.

steps.title: Coating inspection
steps.text: Applied finishes, including UV and spot-UV, drip-off, food-grade and custom coatings, are checked for coverage, alignment, consistency and the required appearance before the sheets move on to die-cutting.
steps.caption_2: Checking coated sheets at the coating line
steps.caption_3: Measuring the finish across a coated sheet

steps.title: Automated carton inspection
steps.text: After die-cutting, an automated inspection machine with 3D cameras examines every unit carton for colour, print defects, registration and missing elements, rejecting any that fall outside the approved reference before folding and gluing.
steps.caption_2: Inspected unit cartons leaving the sorting machine

steps.title: Security features checked
steps.text: Where a carton carries anti-counterfeit features such as colour-shifting seals, hot-stamped or thermal foils and raised spot coatings, each is checked for position, coverage and effect. Because these features are built into the carton, they cannot be reproduced by relabelling.

steps.title: Digital Product Tracking
steps.text: Tablets installed at every production stage let operators record each job card as work progresses, so every order carries its board lot, plates, press, operators and checks. Clients also receive access to this digital tracking system to follow the status of their products with us.

cta.heading: Packaging you can rely on.
cta.text: Talk to us about your quality requirements and we'll show you how we meet them.

items.title: Colour standards
items.text: Shades are matched by a specialised colour team against Pantone formula guides, then verified on press with a spectrophotometer rather than by eye.

items.title: Security built in
items.text: Colour-shifting seals, hot-stamped and thermal foils and custom coatings are printed and finished as part of the carton, so they cannot be peeled off and reapplied to a counterfeit.

items.title: Full traceability
items.text: Tablets at every production stage record each job card as work progresses. Clients get access to the same tracking, so they can follow their own products through our floor.

items.title: Registered and compliant
items.text: Incorporated with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan in 2016, registered with the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Directorate of Labour under the Factories Act, registered with the Federal Board of Revenue, and a corporate member of the Sarhad Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
